summary.text: Dennis Grindel is the Republican candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Emily Hane in a race with no incumbent.
He ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Grindel won the Republican primary for District 31 on August 2, 2022, and lost the November 2022 general election to incumbent Louis Ruiz (D), 73.8 percent to 26.2 percent.
He again won the Republican primary on August 6, 2024, and lost to Ruiz in the general election, 70.3 percent to 29.7 percent.
Ballotpedia lists him as having signed the U.S. Term Limits Pledge in 2024, and he advanced from the Republican primary again on August 4, 2026.
